test_title: Arithmetical and Numerical Ability Mock Test 15

questions.question: A number, when decreased by 1%, gives 3960. The number is:
The arithmetic mean of the observations 12, 46, 83, 43, 97, 34, 31, 33 and 26 is:6334
In what time (in years) will ₹5,000 fetch an interest of ₹900 at 9% per year simple interest?
Income of Amit in 2019 was ₹25,600. He gets an increment of 10% every year. What was his income (in ₹) in 2021?
The volume (in m3) of a cuboidal tank, whose dimensions are given as 23 m × 23 m × 9 m, is:
How many seconds will a boy take to run one complete round around a square field of side 30 metres, if he runs at a speed of 3 km/hr?

An article is sold at a profit of 49%. If the cost price is increased by ₹40 and the selling price is reduced by ₹55, then the profit would be 47.5%. What is the original cost price (in ₹) of the article?
The average age of 22 students of a class is 11 years. If the age of the teacher is also included, the average age of the whole group becomes 12 years. The age (in years) of the teacher is:6126
If an item marked at ₹8,100 is sold for ₹810, what is the discount percentage?
A conical tent has to accommodate 75 persons. Each person must have 10 m2 of space on the ground and 95 m3 of air to breathe. Find the approximate height (in m) of the tent.289

A train overtakes two persons walking along a railway track. The first one walks at 9 km/hr. The other one walks at 10.8 km/hr. The train needs 10 and 12.5 seconds, respectively, to overtake them. What is the speed of the train if both the persons are walking in the same direction as the train?11067

The population of a village increases by 5% every year. At the end of 2022, the population of the village was 11,02,500. Find the population of the village at the beginning of 2020, assuming that 1,025 people had migrated from the village in that year.
